issues: The translation is accurate and uses appropriate polite style, but the stacked modifier "완전히 참조된 알파벳순 2단계 디렉터리 개요" reads somewhat awkwardly in Korean, particularly "참조된" applied to "개요" (overview) rather than clarifying it means an overview with full cross-references.
